subject: STUDENTS: Get Your Draft Applications Into the System!

messages.subject: STUDENTS: Get Your Draft Applications Into the System!
parts:
Students,

It is imperative that you get your draft application in to the Google
GSoC system as soon as possible!

You will need to submit a final application no later than the Google
Deadline on Friday. Google's deadlines are firm, and there are no
exceptions.

Your chances of being selected for one of a limited number of slots
increase if you get feedback on your application from the R mentors,
both the mentors for your project and the broader R mentor community.

For us to comment on your application, it needs to be posted. Google is
recommending that you draft application be posted as a Google Doc, and
that you allow comments by anyone with the link, so that when we
(mentors) click through we can see and comment on your application.

Regards,

Brian
